comparison.objective: Join a flute head joint to its body and rotationally align the embouchure hole with the keys.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual cylindrical insertion, axial seating, and rotational alignment.
comparison.success_condition: Joint fully seated and aligned; assembled flute placed keys-up and released.
comparison.reason: Although it includes fine rotation and bimanual stabilization, it tests insertion and visual alignment rather than unlocking a retained adjustment, tuning physical dynamics, and verifying lock retention.
